en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a war trophy: a mitrailleuse mounted on a plinth and chained off in a barracks courtyard. A uniformed soldier stands to the right; long one-story barracks buildings surround the parade ground. The caption identifies Großenhain and the K.S. 1 Husaren-Regiment "König Albert" Nr. 18, and notes the gun as a gift from King Albert from the 1870/71 war. Publisher credit Bruck & Sohn, Meissen appears.
